preserved_constraints.text: P.SECRET_BOUNDARY and P.MODEL_CREDENTIAL remain nondegradable. Credentials never enter ordinary Agent/Worker facades, prompts, contexts, audit or artifact persistence.
Same-account DPAPI is not Worker isolation. No ACL/account/AppContainer changes were performed or authorized by this review; production and LIVE credential admission remain BLOCKED.
Model text, hook events, review reports and PASS-shaped JSON do not grant a Gate or Tool permit. G4 requires registered trusted checker execution over exact immutable evidence.
Ordinary Tool Gateway PROCESS/EXTERNAL_EFFECT and unqualified sandbox paths retain prior hard rejection. Model routing or escalation cannot enlarge permissions.
Uncertain sends, usage, callbacks and producer/helper closure retain owner-held reservations/slots. They cannot automatically retry, release, or turn UNKNOWN into SUCCESS.

Prompt reconstruction uses exact archived context and manifest bytes. Review binding includes project/repository/base/head/diff/candidate/source/rules; stale commits invalidate prior review authority.
One trusted Storage Owner controls ordinary managed persistence. Public Host/NativeState/raw SQL interfaces remain TCB and are not an OS boundary.
Preserve M1.7 started + INCONCLUSIVE as UNKNOWN even for empty commands or declared-closed commands; only explicit blocked, not-started, zero-command proof can release.
Strict CPU hard limit remains unqualified/BLOCKED; Ubuntu/real network and other unexecuted capabilities stay NOT_RUN. No historical PASS is relabeled from fixtures.

Native core is reimplemented; reusable dependencies require provenance/license closure. Workflow hooks and compaction do not replace authorization or the original archive; BYPASSED is not PASS and no workflow switch disables L0.

findings.fix: Admission and dispatch now finish in preflight before credential reveal. Send performs synchronous qualification, signal, exact admission/approval and store-fault checks immediately before HTTPS construction.
verification: Frozen transport.ts final changed region reread.
Authorization tests and review-fixes preflight-capacity test passed.
Earlier mock-only Key-disable-in-dispatch-ACK attack reproduced one attempted HTTPS construction; moving dispatch before decryption removes that await window. No real network call was made.

findings.title: Artifact failure sidecar could persist a known secret from abort reason.code

findings.title: Producer cleanup could throw arbitrary text or release capacity without confirmed closure
findings.fix: Synchronous cleanup exceptions are contained. Any guarded preflight that exits before iterator completion faults the owner as SOURCE_CLEANUP_UNKNOWN; void return is not closure evidence.

findings.title: Independent Vault connections could silently scan different known-secret sets
findings.fix: Persist import generation; stale guards reject until explicit bounded refresh. Refresh verifies generation after all decrypt awaits, preserves old patterns, and binds patterns to opaque handles.
verification: Independent dual-connection fixture originally returned ACCEPTED_UNSCANNED.
After fix it returned VAULT_GUARD_STALE before refresh and VAULT_KNOWN_SECRET_BLOCKED after refresh.
Final Vault refresh/generation regions reread.

findings.title: Vault state and security event retention had no declared capacities
findings.fix: Keys <= 128, imports <= 1024, request evidence <= 4096, events <= 256 plus saturated lifetime count; live evidence is not evicted.
verification: Final Vault capacity code reread.

findings.title: Rotating credentials could bypass their original expiry
findings.fix: Refresh now expires ROTATING keys. Both the initial and post-decrypt credential fences independently check expires_at and permit only ACTIVE/ROTATING.

After fix the same fixture returned VAULT_KEY_NOT_SENDABLE, callback_calls=0 and old_state=EXPIRED.
Final frozen Vault changed regions reread; new before/during-decrypt expiry regression test fully read. No OS clock change occurred.

findings.title: Rotating a rate-limited key could allow automatic cooldown resurrection
findings.fix: Rotation permanently disables the old RATE_LIMITED key, retaining existing evidence/leases while preventing automatic re-entry to the pool.
verification: Independent synthetic clock fixture disabled the replacement and advanced beyond old cooldown; final result VAULT_NO_ELIGIBLE_KEY, old_state=DISABLED.
Final rotation clause and new cooldown regression test fully read. No OS clock change occurred.
